--environment-form: src/dark-system.css:67 = radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 65% at 100% 88%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand-red-primary-deep) 52%,transparent),transparent 72%),var(--studio-neutral-key),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 52%,var(--light-faded),transparent 68%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 96% 44%,var(--brand-red-wine),transparent 72%),var(--studio-base)

src/index.css: :where(button, a, input, textarea, select):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--primary)); outline-offset: 4px; }
background: radial-gradient(220px circle at var(--light-x, 50%) var(--light-y, 50%), hsl(var(--primary) / .65), var(--bg-panel) 35%, transparent 70%);
-webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); mask-composite: exclude;
.cinematic-navigation { background-color: var(--bg-panel); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 hsl(0 0% 100% / .8); transition-property: background-color, border-color, box-shadow; }

.cinematic-navigation[data-scrolled="true"] { background-color: var(--bg-panel); border-bottom-color: hsl(var(--primary) / .16); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -26px hsl(220 20% 12% / .35), inset 0 1px 0 hsl(0 0% 100% / .85); }
.hero-qa-btn:hover, .premium-btn-primary:hover { transform: perspective(900px) translateY(-3px) rotateX(3deg); box-shadow: 0 16px 26px -18px hsl(var(--primary) / .55); }
